# Algorithms

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_algorithm_docs.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

CRCForge has 134 algorithms: all 113 CRCs from the [RevEng CRC catalogue](https://reveng.sourceforge.io/crc-catalogue/all.htm) and 21 checksums. Each one is tested against its published check value (the result for `123456789`). `crcforge self-test` runs that test and `crcforge info <name>` shows one entry.

Names ignore case and `/`, `_` and `-` mean the same thing, so `CRC-16/MODBUS` and `crc_16_modbus` both work.

## CRCs

Parameters use RevEng notation. Status is RevEng's model class: *attested* means defined in a standards document and corroborated (worked example, implementation or codewords); *confirmed* means backed by a widely available implementation; *academic* means it is not confirmed that CRCs are calculated this way in the field; *third-party* means all parameters come from unofficial sources.
